description: Move layers in time without changing their length: put the In or Out point at a time ([ and ]: the current time; or the composition start or end), alone or as a set keeping offsets; nudge by frames (Alt+Page Up/Down) or seconds; stagger them in order (Quick Offset); or slip-edit the source under fixed In and Out points

asSet.description: in_point_to and out_point_to: move the layers together so the earliest In point (or latest Out point) lands on the time. Default false

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

frames.description: offset, stagger, slip: frames (negative is earlier)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

mode.description: in_point_to, out_point_to (use at), offset (by frames or seconds), stagger (each layer one step later than the one before, in the order given), slip (move the source by frames or seconds inside the In and Out points)

seconds.description: offset, stagger, slip: seconds instead of frames

name: move_layers
title: Move Layers
